newsitem.title: USA: Wainoco's Frontier to use Citgo brand.
newsitem.headline: Wainoco's Frontier to use Citgo brand.

text.p: Wainoco Oil Corp said Wednesday its subsidiary, Frontier Refining, has entered into a distributor franchise agreement with CITGO Petroleum Corp.
The agreement authorizes Frontier to offer the CITGO brand and associated consumer benefits to retailers who buy their refined products from Frontier, Wainoco said.

Frontier will act as CITGO's branding representative in a specified marketing area in the Rocky Mountain region. Valley Oil Company of Scottsbluff, Neb., became the first distributor to sign up with Frontier to be branded CITGO.
Other distributors are currently discussing the move with Frontier.

The CITGO distributor franchise agreement allows Frontier to offer its customers a direct association with a national brand that has the largest number of retail branded locations in the U.S. Frontier customers will be able to have access to CITGO's proprietary credit card and pay-at-the-pump systems.
